entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Criminal
Appellate Jurisdiction
Anticipatory Bail Application No. 975 Of 2023

Amit Govind Vibhute ..Applicant
 v/s.
 The State of Maharashtra .

..Respondents
 Ms. Manisha Devkar for the Applicant.
 Mr. Shrikant Yadav, App for the State.
 Coram : Anuja Prabhudessai ,J.
Dated : 3rd April, 2023.
P.C.
1.

This is an application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. filed by the aforesaid Applicant apprehending his
arrest in C.R.No.106 of 2023 registered with Mangalvedha Police Station, Solapur for offences under
Section 188, 272, 273 and 328 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 26(2)(i), 26(2)(ii),
26(2)(iv), 3(1)(zz)(iv), 59 of Food and Safety Standards Act, 2006.
2. Heard learned Counsel for the Applicant, learned APP for the State.
I have perused the records and considered the submissions advanced by the learned Counsel for the respective parties .
3. The records indicate that pickup van No. MH-08-W-4399, transporting Gutkha was intercepted.
It is alleged that the driver had disclosed that the said Gutkha was owned by the Applicant and was being transported at his instance.

4. The issue relating to the applicability of Section 328 of IPC is pending before the Honourable Supreme Court.

Under the circumstances, the Applicant is granted interim bail on the following terms and conditions:-
(i) In the event of arrest of the Applicant in Crime No.106 of 2023 registered with Mangalvedha Police Station, Solapur, the Applicant be released on interim bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with one or two sureties in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigation Officer.
(ii) The Applicant shall report to the Investigating Officer for two days on 10th and 11th April, 2023, and further as and when required by the Investigating Officer.
(iii) The Applicant shall keep the Investigating Officer informed of his current address and mobile/contact details, and/or change of residence or mobile/contact details from time to time.
(iv) The Applicant shall not interfere with the witnesses, or tamper with the evidence in any manner.

. Stand over to 17th April, 2023,
 (ANUJA PRABHUDESSAI, J.)
